target_customer: Bars, restaurants and retail venues (get the service free); brands and advertisers pay for in-venue TV ad slots
problem: Venue TVs are an unmanaged cost; commercial breaks on cable show irrelevant national ads. Taiv detects breaks and swaps in targeted ads and content, sharing ad revenue with the venue.
business_model: Ad-supported: free hardware box to venues, ad sales with revenue share back to venue
product_category: In-venue CTV/digital out-of-home advertising with AI video detection

founders.name: Noah Palansky
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio; BetaKit says company began from a conversation at a hockey game in a bar

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed live video classification to detect commercial breaks plus a hardware box and source switching, in 2018-2020; standard ML engineering with some hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: Value rests on installed venue base and advertiser relationships; the detection tech was reproducible by funded rivals. No strong sourced moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Taiv. Taiv itself acquihired Local Reach, a Kingston startup with a similar solution.

market_need_then: Venues wanted revenue from TVs and brands wanted bar audiences; no dated demand evidence found beyond the founders' story and early venue adoption (launched in the US south in 2021).

identity.visual_style: Dark design system with a coral-to-violet gradient (company blog)
identity.voice_and_tone: Taglines 'Business TV Reimagined' and 'The AI OS for business TV'

brand_strength.rationale: No source found about the brand itself; rated low-middle by default because nothing shows it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Taiv is active and growing: it launched in 2021, reported 1,000+ bars and restaurants plus 1,000+ retail locations in 14 US cities by mid-2025, and raised a US$6M seed, a Series A of US$7.75M equity plus US$2.75M debt, and a further US$13M round in 2026. The free-to-venue ad-share model solved venue supply cheaply, but revenue and profitability are not disclosed.
notes: Seed of US$6M is one aggregate over three tranches (late 2021 to early 2024), date set to the first tranche. The 2026 round (US$13M, 'Series A plus') is supported by headlines from The Logic and Refresh Miami only; a valuation of 'nearly $100M' appears in one search snippet and is unverified. Total raised varies by source (US$16.5M BetaKit mid-2025, CB Insights 23.65M). No competitors dated near the 2020 batch were found (AdExchanger BarBoards article is undated here; CB Insights lists True Sync Media, EverPass, Barcast without dates). Sources conflict on founding and launch: 2018 founding, YC W20, US launch 2021. No outcome event found (no shutdown or layoffs reported in searches). Name origin and domain history not found.
